pages.text: Farmer's Delight runs the kitchen: cutting boards, cooking pots, skillets, and meals that feed you for a long time. Simple meals carry you through the first season; the good stuff needs a stove and ingredients from more than one biome.$(br2)Fish with Aquaculture rods and nets — rivers and oceans have different fish, and some are worth money.

Animals are from Animania: breeds, genders, feed and water troughs. A cow that is fed and watered gives milk; one that is not, will not. Animals need care, and they reward it.$(br2)Season matters: see Land, Seasons & Weather for what grows when, and why a greenhouse is worth building before winter.
